findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 3-302.11(A)(3) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (3) Cleaning equipment and utensils as specified under 4-602.11(A) and sanitizing as specified under § 4-703.11.

The ice machine has several locations with pink and black/green mold growth. The PIC was shown and cleaned the equipment during the inspection to correct the immediate violation. This is the third inspection in a row where this violation has been noted. Ensure that all food contact surfaces of equipment are maintained clean at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the quat sanitizer in the three part sink registered low on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC indicated that they had not remade this since they arrived. They also stated that one tablet is used in the sink when made. The sink holds approximately 3-4gallons of water and the instructions on the chemical bottle indicate a minimum of 1 tablet to 1.5 gallons of water to reach a minimum concentration of 200 ppm. Education was conducted and the sink remade to correct the violation. Ensure that sanitizer concentrations are at effective levels at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The soda gun has pathogenic growth in abundance observed under the nozzle. The PIC was shown. They stated that the equipment was soaked nightly. This is not sufficient by itself. Ensure that the item is CLEANED and SANITIZED daily. The items was cleaned during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment:
5-402.13: SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW. 

The pipe to the north east corner of the basement still has ponding water underneath and obvious drips forming on the pipe. PIC indicated that it is likely from the 3 part sink at the bar being emptied all at once. Inspector indicated that no waste water should be able to come out of the pipes as they are being conveyed. The ponding water should be cleaned up and the piping resealed (by a professional) to ensure that water is not discharged improperly in the future. Follow up in 3 days for compliance. PIC was shown both locations during this inspection.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

Reporting agreements were not available for employees at this facility during this inspection. Blank copies of the SCDPH Reporting Agreement were given to the PIC during this inspection. They are instructed to ensure that they are completed for all food employees prior to the follow up. Follow up would normally be on 7/27/23. Due to inspector vacation the follow up is being set for 7/31/23.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. 

Vomit/ diarrheal clean up procedures were not available during this inspection. The procedures given by SCDPH were given during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Numerous colonies of black slime/mold are observed on the flip tray in the ice machine. PIC was directed to this location and cleaned the item during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). 

Multiple pots, pans and utensils are observed soiled in the three part sink downstairs. Per the PIC the kitchen has not been used since Monday, indicting that the equipment was not cleaned sufficiently at the end of shift. Foods debris is also observed hard. PIC is instructed to clean all soiled equipment/utensils at the end of each shift.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The covered edge of the soda gun next to the holes is observed soiled with bacterial slime. PIC was consulted and the item cleaned during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf).

A partially used gallon of milk in the refrigerator in the kitchen has a manufacturer use by date of 7/10/23. Today is 7/13/23. The situation was discussed with the PIC and the container discarded during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). 

A bag of pulled pork, a bag of potato salad and an open pint of milk are all observed without date marking in the kitchen. The potato salad and the pulled pork are from an event Monday and a date mark was allowed to be placed on them for corrective action. The milk was unable to have an opening date determined and was discarded. Date marking in general was discussed with the PIC.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival, no sanitizer was available for use. A bucket was made up during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed
findings.comment:
5-402.13: SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW. 

Ponding waste water is observed around the waste conveying pipes downstairs by the alcohol cage. Also, by the north east corner of the basement, a pipe has a dripping leak.  Contact a plumbing professional for repair.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Cooking procedures for chili were discussed with he cook and owner. They stated chili is cooked in a large batch and cooled and reheated in smaller batches. There was a new batch of chili cooking on the stove during the inspection. The owner stated they would stop cooling and reheating chili. They may decide to change to a class 1 establishment. 

3-201.11: Cooling and reheating is a Class 1 activity, and class 2 facilities are not permitted to cool and reheat foods. Ensure cooling and reheating practices no longer occur in order to stay within permit requirements.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Raw chicken was observed stored above sauces and ready to eat foods in the fridge. The chicken was moved to the bottom shelf of the cooler during the inspection. Ensure raw foods are stored below ready to eat foods. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Mold was observed on the ice machine where ice is dispensed. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned at a frequency to prevent mold and mildew growth. The ice machine was cleaned during the inspection to correct the violation. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The walk in cooler fan was observed soiled with dust and other debris. Ensure the fan is cleaned as frequently as necessary to prevent the accumulation of soils. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Raw shell eggs observed stored on the top shelf of the kitchen fridge, over pre-cooked bacon and a large bag of tortilla chips. CORRECTED— Eggs moved to storage on a lower shelf, below RTE foods.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display. [P]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The manager's Certified Food Manager's license expired 10/30/2019. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. Documentation was emailed to the manager about CFM courses available. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text: 2-102.11(C)(2) (Pf) Employee reporting agreements were not signed by staff. Employee reporting agreements, which states that employees will inform the manager/PIC if they are sick, must be signed by all employees. A copy of an employee reporting agreement was given to the manager, and these documents were explained.  Reference 2-102.11(C)(2).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment: 4-204-112  (C) A thermometer is not provided in the kitchen cooler. Cold/Hot holding equipment used for Time/Temperature Control for Safety food shall have at least one thermometer in an easily viewed location. A thermometer was placed inside the cooler during the inspection. Reference 4-204-112.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) and (C)  (C)  Observed an accumulation of grease and food debris on the baffles of the fryer hood.  Thoroughly clean the baffles of the fryer hood to prevent contamination of food and for fire prevention. The hood is cleaned every 6 months by CFB Inc. Steam Specialties. Reference 4-601.11(B) and (C).

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
PIC's food manager certificate expired on 10/30/2019. Facility must be under the supervision of a CFM during all times of food prep and service.
The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Taco meat is not marked with a use-by date. CORRECTED- PIC stated that taco meat was used for yesterday's special, and was not intended for service beyond that. Staff last night should have discarded it. PIC voluntarily discarded taco meat.
3-501.17 Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours must be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the food must be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 41°F or less for a maximum of 7 days. (Pf)

Honey whiskey BBQ marked 10/21 exceeds 7 day date marking rule. CORRECTED- Discussed date marking procedures as they apply to commerically prepared foods. Unless manufacturer states otherwise, commerically processed foods must follow 7-day date marking. Food was discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17 Food shall be clearly marked, at the time the original container is opened in a food establishment and if the food is held for more than 24 hours, to indicate the date or day by which the food shall be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded, when held at a temperature of 41 deg F or less for a maximum of 7 days (not exceeding a manufacturer's use-by date).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment: A thermometer is not provided in the kitchen fridge. Cold/Hot holding equipment used for Time/Temperature Control for Safety food shall have at least one thermometer in an easily viewed location.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112 (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Ceilings in the kitchen (above the fridge) and bar (above the handwashing sink) were found in a state of disrepair
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Potentially hazardous foods properly thawed
findings.comment:
750-240 Potentially hazardous foods shall be properly thawed by one of the  following method. 1. Under refrigeration 41°F or below, 2. Under  potable running water 70°F or below or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose food particles into the over-flow, 3. In microwave as part of the cooking process, 4. As part of the cooking process.
Bags of chicken were observed in a tub of water thawing in the 3 part sink. Potentially hazardous foods should be thawed in one of the methods stated above. The water was turned on to comply with the code.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

The kitchen area of the facility uses a CL based sanitizer and only Quat test strips were in the facility at the time of the inspection. Discussed with the PIC and stated that they need to maintain the proper test strips for each type of sanitizer in the facility.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.
Observed the bucket of sanitizer in the kitchen area to register at approximately 10 part per million (ppm) Chlorine (CL). CL based sanitizers should be at 100 ppm for contact sanitizing. Discussed with the person in charge and the bucket was remade.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory. 
1) Observed the hand sink in the women's bathroom to be without paper towels. 2) Observed the hand sink next to the 3 part sink to be without paper towels.  Discussed with the PIC and stated that all hand sinks need to be maintained with soap and a way to dry hands in a sanitary way.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

Observed the hood system in the kitchen area to be heavily soiled with accumulated grease. Discussed with the PIC and instructed to clean often enough so as to prevent the accumulation of filth and to prevent the contamination of prepared foods.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
1) Observed cut tomatoes to be in the prep cooler without a date mark. Employee states they were cut yesterday. Ensure that PHFs are labeled within 24 hours of being opened, made, or cut. 2) Observed chili in the cooler that was dated 11/26/2017. Manager explained the cooking, cooling, freezing, and reheating process of this chili, but it is unknown when the product was thawed. Ensure that the date the product is thawed is placed on the product as well. This will allow the facility track the 7 days it is allotted for service. 3) Observed pimento cheese with a date mark of 11/19/2017. Ensure that PHFs are discarded 7 days after opening. Chili and Pimento cheese discarded during the inspection. Tomatoes were date marked during the inspection. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
1) Observed raw egg being stored on top of RTE product in the prep cooler. Ensure that raw product is not stored on top of RTE products to prevent potentials for cross contamination. 2) Observed raw chicken sitting over the beer lines and beer products in the cooler. Ensure that raw product is not over RTE products or food contact surfaces. A spot check will be conducted to ensure that products are in the proper storage order. 3) Observed mold growing on the water contact surfaces of the ice machine. Ensure that the machine is regularly cleaned to prevent potentials for cross contamination. 
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
1) Observed the following items to be out of temperature control in the kitchen (all items probed): 1) Chicken breast (60F, refrigerator), 2) Lunch Meat Ham (55F, refrigerator), 3) Lunch Meat Ham (49F, prep cooler), and 4) Cheese (57F, prep cooler). Ensure that all PHFs are maintained at 41F while being cold held. All items discarded. 2) Observed pulled pork and cottage cheese to be without a date mark. Ensure that once RTE, PHFs are opened they are date marked within 24 hours, then used or discarded within 7 days. Items date marked during the inspection with the date they were opened. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed raw stored above RTE food in the refrigerator in the kitchen. RTE food was moved above the raw food during the inspection. Ensure that raw food is stored above RTE food and in the proper storage order. 
750-130(d)  All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the prep cooler door, in the kitchen, to be sitting slanted on its hinges. This is allowing a gap in where the seal ends and the opening begins. This could cause the cooler to go into a failure due to the lack of seal. Ensure that the non-food contact surfaces are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice machine, behind the bar, to have a build up of mold in the rear. Ensure that food contact surfaces are regularly cleaned. The mold was not contacting the ice. 
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the 3 compartment sink to have a leak below the far left sink. 2) Observed a leak from the water line above the soda syrup rack. Ensure that the plumbing is repaired so that it is in good repair and does not leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a pool of water around the edge of the basement floor. Owner states they have a leak around the top of the walls in the basement. Ensure that this water is removed and the area cleaned. The top of the walls should be repaired to prevent water from leaking in around them. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Observed plumbing under the three compartment sink by the grease trap that appeared to not have an air-gap or go through the grease trap. Pictures were taken and sent to Stan Clouse at City of Springfield Public Works. Stan stated the plumbing could cause a potential issue with back siphonage and the plumbing should be repaired to provide an air gap. Ensure that any plumbing repairs are done by an IL licensed plumber. 
750-1060 There shall be no cross-connection between the safe-water supply and any unsafe or questionable water supply, or any source of pollution through which the safe water supply might become contaminated. Abate in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a common practice throughout the facility of not date marking refrigerated PHFs. Ensure that if a refrigerated PHF is opened that it is date marked with the date it was opened, then used within 7 days or discarded. Many of these items are stated to be from St. Patrick's Day Parade. Items are being discarded during the inspeciton. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
1) Observed the bottom of the prep cooler to have raw meat sitting on top of ready to eat items. 2) Observed raw items stored in the refridgerator that are intermingled with ready to eat items. Ensure that raw foods are stored in the proper order to prevent potentials for cross contamination. There is also employee's personal food intermingled within the raw food and service food. Manager is in the middle of reorganizing the coolers. Facility will be spot checked at a later date to ensure proper storage orders. 
750-130(d)  All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed soda syrup boxes stored on the floor in the basement. Ensure that food or products used for consumption are stored at least 6 inches off the floor to prevent cross contamination. 
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed a sanitizer bucket stored under the bar that the owner stated was from the night before. Ensure that waste water is emptied at the end of each use or service day. Sanitizer bucket was emptied during the inspection. 
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the kitchen to have an accumulation of food debris, grease, and general trash on the floor. 2) Observed the coving in the men's restroom to be pulling away from the wall. Ensure that the coving is resealed to the wall or caulked to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Also make sure floors are maintained in good repair, as well as in a clean state. 
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed a spray bottle with a blue liquid in it that was unlabeled, in the basement on the mop sink. Ensure that all chemicals are properly labeled to make sure they are used properly. Bottle was allowed to be labeled during the inspection. 
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed milk in the refridgerator across from the walk-in to be half empty with no date marking. Milk was opened on 12/19/2016 per the owner. Owner was allowed to date mark the milk at this time. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed raw bacon and raw boneless pork chops stored with ready to eat turkey and limes. Ensure that raw food is stored in the proper cold storage manner so that it does not cross contaminate other food items. 
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed a cooked pizza stored within the pizza oven that was from the night before. Ensure that hot foods are either stored hot or follow a time as control policy. Pizza was discarded by inspector.
750-150(b)  Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135°F or above except during the cooling process. Store hot foods at 135°F or above. (Except for rare roast beef which may be held at 130F.)

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
1) Observed raw chicken above both beef and fish in the prep cooler. 2) Observed raw beef sitting next to cheese slices and ready to eat turkey meat in the refridgerator in the back storage area. Ensure that foods follow the proper order of storage to prevent cross-contamination potentials.  
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed popcorn being stored on the floor inside a popcorn machine in the basement. Ensure that food is properly protected or discard it following use. 
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the fryer on the left to be without a door. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are smooth, easily cleanable, and in good repair. Provide a door for the fryer.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed dishes on the floor in the basement that were soiled with mold growing on leftover food. 2) Also, the ice machine has mold accumulation on parts of the water pump. Ensure that food contact surfaces are maintained in good repair, as well as clean. 
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed food debris on multiple surfaces all throughout the kitchen. The owner states they do not clean the kitchen at night. Ensure that non-food contact surfaces are maintained in a clean fashion.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single-service to go containers stored with the food contact surface side up. Ensure that single-service articles are stored in a manner that prevents contamination. Invert the to go containers.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Observed mop water in the basement that was obviously not discarded from the day before. Ensure that mop water is discarded after finished with use. Manager discarded the mop water. 
750-1050 All water containing sewage shall be disposed of  properly either by a public sewage system or an approved private disposal system which is constructed and operated in conformance with applicable State and local laws, ordinances and regulations.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink in the kitchen to be without hand towels. Provide paper towels. 
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Observed mouse droppings in the first cabinet in the bar area. There appears to also be a trail leading out of the cabinet. Owner states that Adams is their pest control and the last time they were out was 6 months ago. Adams should be contacted for service and have a visit prior to the next survey.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Floor in the following areas are soiled or in disrepair: 1) Floors in the kitchen has an accumulation of food debris from the night before. 2) Floor in the bar area under the three part sink has a hole that is not sealed. 3) Floors in the cabinets are soiled with mouse droppings. 
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a ceiling tile above the bar missing with wires coming out the area. Provide a ceiling tile. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed chemicals being stored with spices and above a food prep table. Ensure chemicals are stored below and away from foods and food contact surfaces. Manager moved the chemicals. 
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-151(a) Observed a gallon of milk and an opened container of soup in the hallway cooler to not be date marked. Mark potentially hazardous, ready-to-eat foods with the date of open/creation and use within 7 days. Labeled during inspection. Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-160  Observed a carton of eggs to be stored on the second shelf over other ready to eat foods. Moved to the lower shelf (with other carton of eggs) during the inspection. Discussed marking of 'Employee Foods' on a shelf in this cooler. Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: 750-1120e See violation #32. There were no paper towels available at the bar handsink. Bartender is using a common towel. Cease use of a common towel.  Hand-cleansing soap shall be available at each lavatory. Sanitary towels or a heated air hand-drying device shall be conveniently located near each lavatory. Common towels are prohibited. If disposable towels are provided a waste receptacle shall be conveniently located near the hand washing facilities.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: 750-820d Observed bartender washing, rinsing, and sanitizing dishes without allowing for proper contact time on dishes in sanitizing solution. Discussed allowing glasses to rest in solution for 60 seconds. Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b No sanitizing solution bucket is available at the bar. Provide a sanitizing bucket for wet wiping cloths. Wet wiping cloths are observed on the counter and hanging on the ski railing. Sani-bucket was created during the inspection. Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the box fan in the kitchen (not currently in operation) to be soiled with dust and grease. Also, observed the drip tray of the oven to be soiled with accumulated pizza spills. Clean the fan and the drip tray. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750-1130(e) Observed the mop bucket in the basement to be full of old, waste wash water. Discard used mop water after each use. Also, observed a tub of waste water under the third sink of the three compartment sink in the basement. Tub is nearly full of greasy water. Make sure that water is being emptied and tub is being cleaned on a nightly basis. Repair the leak so that the waste water collection tub is not needed.  Liquid waste from compacting or cleaning operations shall be disposed of as sewage.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750-1120e There are no paper towels available at the bar handsink. Provided during the inspection.  A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 Observed mouse droppings in the first cabinet (underneath the handsink) and to the far right open cabinet area. Droppings are green. Discussed cleaning and organizing of cabinets. Facility has CT Adams for pest control. No other pest issues were observed within the building.  Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 Observed a ceiling tile to be missing from over the bar (to the left of the first t.v.).Replace the ceiling tile.  All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Rooms and equipment - vented as required
findings.comment: 750-1250 Exhaust fans in the basement are observed inoperable.  All rooms shall have sufficient ventilation to keep them free of excessive, heat, steam, condensation, vapors, obnoxious odors, smoke, and fumes. Provide adequate ventilation.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
Observed an employee drink at the bar hand sink with no lid or straw. Drink was discarded and replaced with a cup with a lid and a straw to CORRECT the violation.
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed wet wiping cloths next to the fryers in the kitchen and on the bar coolers at the bar. Sanitizer buckets were provided to CORRECT the violation. Store wet wiping cloths in sanitizer buckets in between use.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels at the kitchen hand sink or at the hand sink in the basement. Paper towels were provided to CORRECT the violation.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed a drain in the basement to not be fixed to the floor. Fix drain to the floor.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed two packages of chicken and one package of fish in refrigeration units that were not in their original packaging that did not have a date label as to when they were removed from the original packaging.
Label all PHF when it is removed from original package.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed that the refrigerator and the prep cooler did not contain thermometers. 
Provide thermometers in all refrigeration units.
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
CORRECTED = Thermometers placed into units.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed a plastic sleeve of disposable food containers that were stored on the floor in the kitchen.
Store single-service items 6 inches off of the floor to protect against potential contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
CORRECTED = Item was placed on a shelf.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Raw wood blocks under fryer have not been painted yet.
(see pre-opening inspection report)

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
750-1080 A hose shall not be attached to a faucet unless a backflow prevention device is installed. Install backflow prevention device.
Vacuum breaker has not been installed on hose to 3 part sink.
(see pre-opening inspection report)

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
Gasket has not been installed on the back door.
(see pre-opening inspection report)
